reviews.rationale: 少量示例超过文中训练基线的方向有直接支持，但现有 scope 与正文的数字口径应修正。ALFWorld 的 34 是 best-of-6 ReAct 成功率 71% 减 best-of-8 BUTLER 的 37%，即 34 个百分点；ReAct 六组提示的平均值为 57%，不能把 34 写成平均提升或相对增幅。WebShop 的 ReAct 40.0% 减 IL 29.1% 为 10.9 个百分点，减 IL+RL 28.7% 为 11.3 个百分点；摘要的 10% 是粗略表述。建议 Wiki 写明比较对象、提示选择口径和“百分点”，并保留仅适用于这两个基准的范围。这是与已存论文表格的一致性核查，没有独立复现实验。

reviews.locator: 第 2 节 ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning + Acting，PDF 第 3 页，动作空间定义段；图 1 在第 2 页
reviews.quote:
The idea of ReAct is simple: we augment the agent’s action space to ˆA =A∪L , whereL is the
space of language. An action ˆat∈L in the language space, which we will refer to as a thought or a
reasoning trace, does not affect the external environment, thus leading to no observation feedback.
Instead, a thought ˆat aims to compose useful information by reasoning over the current contextct,
and update the contextct+1 = (ct, ˆat) to support future reasoning or acting.
reviews.rationale: 原文直接将动作空间扩展为 A∪L，说明 thought 不改变外部环境且不产生观察反馈，并将 thought 追加到上下文。第 2 节后文明确知识任务采用 thought–action–observation 交替，决策任务 thought 可以稀疏出现；Wiki 机制与此一致。只支持论文定义与示例，不能据此证明所有实际 Agent 都遵循该循环，也未核验模型推理轨迹是否反映真实内部计算。

reviews.locator: 第 3.3 节 Results and Observations，PDF 第 6 页，ReAct vs. CoT 的 B 段及 Table 2
reviews.quote:
B) While interleaving reasoning, action and observation steps improves ReAct’s grounded-
ness and trustworthiness, such a structural constraint also reduces its ﬂexibility in formulating
reasoning steps, leading to more reasoning error rate than CoT. we note that there is one frequent
error pattern speciﬁc to ReAct, in which the model repetitively generates the previous thoughts and
actions, and we categorize it as part of “reasoning error” as the model fails to reason about what the
proper next action to take and jump out of the loop4.
reviews.rationale: 原文直接陈述交替结构提升 groundedness，但限制推理步骤的灵活性；Table 2 报告 ReAct 与 CoT 幻觉、推理和检索错误的人工分类。作者分别为两种方法抽取 50 条正确和 50 条错误轨迹，共 200 条，不能将这组条件抽样比例视为整体任务错误发生率，也不能泛化成任意知识任务都会更准确。Wiki scope 限定 HotpotQA 轨迹人工分析，结论在该范围内与原文一致。
